subsystem_designs.conditioning_method: ControlNet layout / soft segmentation map conditioning
subsystem_designs.backend_dependency: ControlNet-seg or equivalent layout map ingestion with multi-control weighting
subsystem_designs.required_input: RuntimeSpatialGraph + exports/source_video_numerical_dna_full frame_coordinates + composition_coordinates per scene frame
subsystem_designs.required_output: Raster layout map (segmentation-style PNG/tensor) per frame + SpatialLayoutMap JSON with normalized element positions

subsystem_designs.backend_dependency: ControlNet depth / MiDaS-derived depth map ingestion pipeline
subsystem_designs.required_input: frame_coordinates + camera_path depth samples + spatial graph depth_edges + depth_layers from numerical DNA
subsystem_designs.required_output: Normalized depth map raster (0=near, 1=far) per frame aligned to source aspect ratio

subsystem_designs.backend_dependency: Pose estimation module + ControlNet OpenPose backend adapter
subsystem_designs.required_input: blocking_data character positions + gaze_constraints + optional skeleton estimation from source frame pairs
subsystem_designs.required_output: OpenPose-style skeletal keypoint raster map per character per frame

subsystem_designs.conditioning_method: Regional prompting + composited layout map masks
subsystem_designs.backend_dependency: Regional prompting backend with per-region weight control and inpainting mask support
subsystem_designs.required_input: blocking_data numerical DNA + character_region constraints + scene_remap character_region_map
subsystem_designs.required_output: Actor region blocking map with character_id labels and interaction pair overlays per frame

subsystem_designs.conditioning_method: IP-Adapter reference image conditioning with identity lock
subsystem_designs.backend_dependency: IP-Adapter or equivalent reference-image identity conditioning backend
subsystem_designs.required_input: Character identity anchors + semantic-preservation-layer + reference portrait embeddings + identity_lock metadata
subsystem_designs.required_output: Identity conditioning bundle: reference image embeddings, lock strength metadata, drift prevention tokens

subsystem_designs.conditioning_method: Regional prompting + environment anchor locks + style reference conditioning
subsystem_designs.backend_dependency: IP-Adapter style reference + regional mask backend + environment lock token injection
subsystem_designs.required_input: EnvironmentAnchorConstraint graph + timesetting lock datasets + environment-motion DNA + anchor_persistence_map
subsystem_designs.required_output: Environment identity map raster + anchor persistence metadata bundle per scene

subsystem_designs.conditioning_method: Multi-control stack (layout + depth + pose) with IP-Adapter identity and regional prompting orchestration
subsystem_designs.backend_dependency: ControlNet-class multi-input backend + Video conditioning backend for temporal shot sequences
subsystem_designs.required_input: Unified bundle: layout_map + depth_map + pose_map + blocking_map + object_identity + environment_identity + ConditionedPromptBuilder text constraints
subsystem_designs.required_output: Single conditioning request payload to image/video diffusion backend with weighted multi-control stack
